name: expense-api

dependencies.name: expense-db
dependencies.description: Stores users (employee/manager/finance, manager relationships), expense claims (including the receipt file as a blob), approval decisions, and payroll export batches.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Validates the caller's Thunder-issued token via the gateway and resolves their role (employee/manager/finance) and identity.

dependencies.name: email-provider
dependencies.description: Sends transactional email on claim submission, approval, and rejection to employees and managers.

description: Backend service owning the full expense-claim lifecycle: submission, editing/resubmission of rejected claims, manager approval/rejection, and finance's payroll export. Sends email notifications on status changes. Does not integrate directly with any payroll system — it only produces an export file for finance to hand off manually.
